Meet the specialists

Dr. Chetan Veeramaneni and Dr. Thopicharla Mounika founded Altus. Meet them here and choose the specialist who can help with your concern.

CVNephrology
Kidney Care

Dr. Chetan Veeramaneni

Nephrologist & Renal Transplant Physician
MBBS, DNB (Gen Med), DM Nephrology (Osmania), F.Diab (UK)

DM Nephrology from Osmania Medical College, with additional training in diabetes and in kidney transplant management at Mayo Clinic, USA. Treats CKD, AKI, glomerular disease, hypertension and diabetic kidney disease, and manages dialysis and transplant care.

  • CKD & AKI
  • Dialysis
  • Transplant
  • Diabetes & BP
  • Kidney biopsy

ENT Care

Dr. T. Mounika

ENT, Head & Neck Surgeon
MBBS, MS (ENT), Fellow in Advanced Rhinology & Skull Base Surgery

MS (ENT) from Mamata Medical College and a fellowship in Advanced Rhinology & Skull Base Surgery from Royal Pearl Hospital, Trichy. Performs endoscopic sinus, ear, throat, thyroid and skull base surgery for adults and children.

  • Sinus & FESS
  • Ear surgery
  • Tonsils & adenoids
  • Thyroid
  • Skull base
